---
title: "`r params$title`"
report-class: model
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    md_extensions: "-native_divs-native_spans"
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
  word_document: default
params:
  title:         "Model report (full)"
  model_name:    ""
  model_desc:    ""
  image_file:    NULL
  logos:         NULL
  figure:        NULL
  config_df:     NULL
  discount_df:   NULL
  horizon_plot:  NULL
  calendar_plot: NULL
  calendar_df:   NULL
  geoscale_df:   NULL
  geo_map:       NULL
  geo_stack:     NULL
  counts_df:     NULL
  comm_df:       NULL
  sup_df:        NULL
  dem_df:        NULL
  trd_df:        NULL
  expimp_df:     NULL
  weather_df:    NULL
  weather_cf_df:    NULL
  weather_heatmaps: NULL
  demand_heatmaps:  NULL
  policy_df:     NULL
  cns_df:        NULL
  proc_groups:        NULL
  techs:              NULL
  procs_note:         NULL
  windows_group_plot: NULL
  windows_group_n:    0
  group_index_df:     NULL
  levcost_df:          NULL
  levcost_cmp_plot:    NULL
  levcost_group_plots: NULL
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{booktabs}
---

```{r en-setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

# Shared helpers live in the package (see ?energyRt::report_helpers).
fmt <- energyRt::report_setup()
tbl <- function(df, caption = NULL, digits = 4L, ...)
  energyRt::report_tbl(df, caption, digits, output = fmt, ...)
emit_img <- function(path, frac = 1)
  energyRt::report_img(path, frac, output = fmt)
```

```{r en-css, results='asis'}
energyRt::report_css(fmt)
```

```{r en-logo, results='asis'}
if (length(params$logos) > 0) {
  energyRt::report_img_row(params$logos, frac_total = 0.9, output = fmt)
} else if (!is.null(params$image_file)) {
  emit_img(params$image_file, 0.25)
}
```

`r if (isTRUE(nzchar(params$model_desc))) params$model_desc`

```{r en-figure, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$figure)}
emit_img(params$figure, 0.5)
```

## Contents

```{r en-counts, results='asis'}
tbl(params$counts_df)
```

```{r en-windows-grp, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$windows_group_plot)}
energyRt::report_fig(params$windows_group_plot, 8,
  h_in = min(9, max(2.5, 1.2 + 0.18 * params$windows_group_n)),
  caption = if (is.null(params$group_index_df))
    "Investment and operating windows of the sampled processes" else
    "Investment and operating windows by process group",
  output = fmt)
```

```{r en-group-index, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$group_index_df)}
tbl(params$group_index_df, caption = "Process-group index", max_rows = 40)
```

```{r en-levcost, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$levcost_cmp_plot) || !is.null(params$levcost_df)}
cat("## Levelized costs (ex-ante)\n\n")
if (!is.null(params$levcost_cmp_plot))
  energyRt::report_fig(params$levcost_cmp_plot, 7.5, caption = "Levelized cost comparison, most expensive first", output = fmt)
for (nm in names(params$levcost_group_plots))
  energyRt::report_fig(params$levcost_group_plots[[nm]], 6.5, 3.0,
    caption = paste("Levelized cost, group", nm), frac = 0.9, output = fmt)
if (!is.null(params$levcost_df))
  tbl(params$levcost_df, caption = "Levelized cost, most expensive first",
      max_rows = 30)
```

## Processes

```{r en-proc-note, results='asis'}
if (length(params$proc_groups) > 0) {
  cat("One section per process group (`misc$report_groups` or ",
      "`report(groups = )`). Per-process datasheets: ",
      "`report(mod, name = \"<process>\")`.\n\n", sep = "")
} else if (!is.null(params$procs_note)) {
  cat(params$procs_note, "\n\n")
}
```

```{r en-proc-groups, results='asis'}
for (g in params$proc_groups) {
  hdr <- if (identical(g$index, g$label)) g$label else
    paste0(g$index, " — ", g$label)
  cat("\n\n### ", hdr, " (", g$class, ", n = ", g$n, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  energyRt::report_img(g$draw_file, 0.6, output = fmt,
                       caption = paste("Structure of", g$representative))
  tbl(g$ranges_df, caption = "Parameter ranges across members")
  tbl(g$detail_df, caption = "Per-member parameters", max_rows = 50)
}
```

```{r en-proc-sample, results='asis', eval=length(params$proc_groups) == 0}
for (t in params$techs) {
  cat("\n\n### ", t$name, " (", t$class, ")\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nzchar(t$desc)) cat(t$desc, "\n\n")
  energyRt::report_img(t$draw_file, 0.6, output = fmt,
                       caption = paste("Structure of", t$name))
  tbl(t$info_df, caption = "Parameters")
}
```
